configurations.//: LOCAL database. Use this one for everyday work: 'vidyapath' below reads .env, and .env points at the live Railway Postgres — so running it locally means every click lands on the school's real data.
configurations.name: vidyapath-local
runtimeArgs: import os; os.environ['DATABASE_URL']='sqlite:///./vidyapath.db'; os.environ['ALLOW_SQLITE']='1'; os.environ.setdefault('JWT_SECRET','d'*40); os.environ['DOTENV_PATH']='nonexistent.env'; import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=8012)

configurations.//: A second LOCAL server, for verifying a change while another one is already running on 8012. Same SQLite database, same isolation from .env.
configurations.name: vidyapath-local-2
runtimeArgs: import os; os.environ['DATABASE_URL']='sqlite:///./vidyapath.db'; os.environ['ALLOW_SQLITE']='1'; os.environ.setdefault('JWT_SECRET','d'*40); os.environ['DOTENV_PATH']='nonexistent.env'; import uvicorn; uvicorn.run('main:app', host='127.0.0.1', port=8015)
